addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since morning -- a settled 1H close above 84,944.4 (which has now capped two attempts: the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick) would confirm the range top is actually breaking. This session's high (84,186.8) stayed well under it.

decisionBox.changed: No change from midday: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched into the overnight window. Price drifted -0.09% and the session range compressed further (83,633.2-84,186.8, the narrowest of the day) -- momentum continues to fade (funding down to +0.0014%, OI down to $2,384.3M, L/S ratio easing to 1.29 from 1.31) without either level actually being tested. Nothing here changes the stance; the only new element is the overnight liquidation-cluster watch (see overnightRisk).

overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT tomorrow (~6.3h from now) -- the widest gap of the day and historically where the sharpest moves happen. The book carries only a small spot core (no futures exposure), so leverage risk is minimal, but the setup itself is fragile: five-plus hours pinned in an 83,633-84,186 band with fading momentum (funding +0.0014%, OI $2,384.3M and still easing, L/S ratio 1.29) is a low-conviction grind, not a base. The nearest liquidation magnet is 83,500 (~2.57 BTC / ~$214k of long liqs, the largest fresh cluster from OKX's last 100 realized fills) with a second stack at 83,250 (~1.62 BTC / ~$135k) -- both only 0.4-0.7% below spot, close enough that a modest overnight dip could cascade toward reduceIf (82,874.5) before the next check-in. Above spot, short liqs are thinner and further (84,000, ~1.95 BTC) so the imbalance skews the tail risk downward. Other overnight catalysts: Sep-25 Bitcoin ETF flow data was not yet published as of this run (would confirm or break the 6-day net-inflow streak), and the daily MACD histogram has now decelerated for a 7th straight session even with price near its highs -- a slow momentum fade that argues for watching the 83,500/83,250 magnets rather than for placing a hard resting stop right now, since spot exposure here is small and price sits >1% above reduceIf.

liquidityMagnet.note: Long liqs stacked below spot (83,500 + 83,250 = ~4.19 BTC) outweigh short liqs stacked above (84,000 + 84,250 = ~2.15 BTC) by roughly 2:1 -- consistent with the L/S account ratio (1.29) showing longs still a touch more crowded.
